title: Can You Pass This 2000s Quiz? 📱 50 Pop Culture Trivia Questions | Pop Culture Quiz #13

questions.question: In the 2001 film, what colour is the grumpy swamp-dwelling ogre Shrek?
questions.reveal: Shrek won the very first Oscar for Best Animated Feature, in 2002.

questions.question: In Shrek (2001), what kind of animal is Shrek's chatty best friend?
questions.reveal: He never stops talking, and later marries the Dragon!

questions.question: Which giant London observation wheel opened to the public in 2000?
questions.reveal: It was built to celebrate the new millennium, beside the River Thames.

questions.question: In the Harry Potter films, what is the name of Harry's snowy white owl?
questions.reveal: Several owls played Hedwig, and the main one was called Gizmo.

questions.question: Which Nintendo console of 2006 had a motion remote you could swing like a tennis racket?
questions.reveal: Wii Sports came bundled with the console in most countries.

questions.question: What was the name of Apple's pocket music player, first launched in 2001?
questions.reveal: The first model held about 1,000 songs on a 5 GB hard drive.

questions.question: In High School Musical (2006), which sport does Troy Bolton play for East High?
questions.reveal: The film was shot at a real school, East High in Salt Lake City, Utah.

questions.question: Which sword-fighting cat in a feathered hat first appeared in Shrek 2 (2004)?
questions.reveal: Puss was so popular that he got his own film in 2011.

questions.question: In Pirates of the Caribbean, what is the name of Captain Jack Sparrow's ship?
questions.reveal: The first film, The Curse of the Black Pearl, sailed into cinemas in 2003.

questions.question: In Finding Nemo (2003), what kind of animal is Crush, the surfer dude who rides the current?
questions.reveal: Crush says he is 150 years old, and still young!

questions.question: In The Lord of the Rings films, which creature calls the One Ring 'my precious'?
questions.reveal: The Return of the King won 11 Oscars in 2004, including Best Picture.

questions.question: In the 2005 film Madagascar, what kind of animal is Marty?
questions.reveal: Marty and his friends escape from New York's Central Park Zoo.

questions.question: In Ice Age (2002), what kind of animal is Manny?
questions.reveal: His herd-mates are Sid the sloth and Diego the sabre-toothed tiger.

questions.question: In Monsters, Inc. (2001), what nickname is given to the girl who sneaks into Monstropolis?
questions.reveal: Boo has her own nickname for big blue Sulley: 'Kitty'!

questions.question: Which 2000 computer game let you build houses and control the lives of little virtual people?
questions.reveal: Sims chat in their own made-up language, called Simlish.

questions.question: Which 2005 video game had players strumming a plastic guitar with coloured fret buttons?
questions.reveal: The original controller had five coloured buttons: green, red, yellow, blue and orange.

questions.question: Which Sony games console, launched in 2000, could also play DVDs?
questions.reveal: It became one of the best-selling games consoles ever made.

questions.question: Which trainers of the 2000s had a wheel hidden in the heel so you could glide along?
questions.reveal: Heelys first rolled into shops in 2000 and sold millions of pairs.

questions.question: From which platform at King's Cross does the Hogwarts Express leave in Harry Potter?
questions.reveal: King's Cross now has a luggage trolley 'disappearing' into the wall for photos.

questions.question: Which video website, launched in 2005, had a first clip called 'Me at the zoo'?
questions.reveal: That first video was filmed at San Diego Zoo and lasts under 20 seconds.

questions.question: Which Nintendo handheld of 2004 had two screens, with a touch screen on the bottom?
questions.reveal: DS stands for 'Dual Screen'.

questions.question: Which 2003 Christmas film follows a human raised by elves at the North Pole?
questions.reveal: He travels to New York to find his real dad, eating spaghetti with syrup!

questions.question: On Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?, which lifeline took away two wrong answers?
questions.reveal: The other two original lifelines were Phone a Friend and Ask the Audience.

questions.question: Which big-eyed fashion dolls were launched in 2001 as a rival to Barbie?
questions.reveal: The four original Bratz dolls were Cloe, Yasmin, Sasha and Jade.

questions.question: In Hannah Montana (2006), what is the real name of the girl secretly living as a pop star?
questions.reveal: She hides her pop-star life by wearing a long blonde wig.

questions.question: Which animated ringtone character went to No. 1 in the UK in 2005 with 'Axel F'?
questions.reveal: The catchy tune was first written by Harold Faltermeyer in 1984.

questions.question: In which year did Apple's first iPhone go on sale?
questions.reveal: It went on sale in the USA on 29 June 2007.

questions.question: In 2006, which planet was reclassified as a 'dwarf planet' by astronomers?
questions.reveal: The decision was made by the International Astronomical Union in Prague.

questions.question: Which phone with a mini keyboard, made by a Canadian company, was named after a fruit?
questions.reveal: BlackBerry phones were made by a company called Research In Motion.

questions.question: Which social network of the 2000s let you choose a 'Top 8' friends on your profile page?
questions.reveal: MySpace launched in 2003, and every new user's first friend was 'Tom'.

questions.question: Which number puzzle, played on a 9×9 grid, became a newspaper craze in 2005?
questions.reveal: The name comes from Japanese and roughly means 'single number'.

questions.question: In Happy Feet (2006), what kind of penguin is Mumble, who can't sing but loves to tap dance?
questions.reveal: Happy Feet won the Oscar for Best Animated Feature in 2007.

questions.question: In Bob the Builder, what do the team shout after 'Can we fix it?'
questions.reveal: The theme song 'Can We Fix It?' was the UK's Christmas No. 1 in 2000.

questions.question: In which online game, launched in 2005, did kids waddle around a snowy island as penguins?
questions.reveal: Players could adopt fluffy pets called Puffles.

questions.question: Which website, launched in 2001, is a free online encyclopedia that anyone can edit?
questions.reveal: Wikipedia went live on 15 January 2001.

questions.question: In Pirates of the Caribbean, who is the octopus-faced captain of the Flying Dutchman?
questions.reveal: He first appeared in Dead Man's Chest, which came out in 2006.

questions.question: Which computer problem, also called the Millennium Bug, worried the world as 2000 approached?
questions.reveal: Y2K means 'Year 2000': the K stands for kilo, meaning one thousand.

questions.question: In Up (2009), what name does Russell give to the giant, colourful bird?
questions.reveal: Up was the first animated film ever to open the Cannes Film Festival.

questions.question: In Night at the Museum (2006), what giant skeleton comes alive and plays fetch?
questions.reveal: The film is set in New York's American Museum of Natural History.

questions.question: In The Lord of the Rings, how many members make up the Fellowship of the Ring?
questions.reveal: Four hobbits, two men, a wizard, an elf and a dwarf.

questions.question: In the cartoon Ben 10 (2005), what is the name of the watch that turns Ben into aliens?
questions.reveal: At first, the watch let Ben turn into ten different aliens.

questions.question: Which social network added its famous 'Like' button in February 2009?
questions.reveal: Facebook started in 2004 as a site for Harvard students only.

questions.question: What nickname was given to the main stadium of the 2008 Beijing Olympics?
questions.reveal: Its official name is the Beijing National Stadium.

questions.question: In Wallace & Gromit's 2005 film, what giant creature is gobbling the town's vegetables?
questions.reveal: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit won the Oscar for Best Animated Feature in 2006.

questions.question: In Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban (2004), what is the hippogriff called?
questions.reveal: A hippogriff is half eagle, half horse.

questions.question: Which free email service did Google launch in 2004, which many people thought was a joke?
questions.reveal: It launched on 1 April, April Fools' Day, with a then-huge 1 GB of storage.

questions.question: Which Nintendo console of 2001 was shaped like a small cube with a handle?
questions.reveal: It used small 8 cm discs instead of full-size DVDs.

questions.question: Which Studio Ghibli film won the Oscar for Best Animated Feature in 2003?
questions.reveal: It was the first anime film ever to win that Oscar.

questions.question: Which pair of Pokémon games, first released in 2006, introduced the Sinnoh region?
questions.reveal: They came out on the Nintendo DS and starred legendaries Dialga and Palkia.

questions.question: In Kim Possible (2002), what kind of animal is Ron Stoppable's pet, Rufus?
questions.reveal: Rufus usually rides around in Ron's trouser pocket.
